body:
NEGATIVE RESULT ON bd-01M1789P5B9WVNCJFN3HXACWKN, posted because new-engineer traced this
one forward and someone might otherwise promote it. IT DOES NOT FIRE. Stays P2.

I filed relativePosition's getOrElse(0.0) with reachability explicitly unmeasured, then
measured it myself because I had written the promotion criterion and nobody was on it. I
expected to promote it to P1. StorySourceView.scala:65-66 says otherwise:

  private val all = allNarrative.filter(n => source.sourceSupport(n).nonEmpty)

`all` is already filtered to supported nodes, so nodes, index, known and
narratedWorldSituations share one domain and node(ref) is TOTAL over every ref the view
exposes. Unsupported nodes never become refs; they are captured in `dropped` with a reason.
The in-place guard at :268 that looks like an author who had been bitten is defensive and
unreachable.

CHAIN: permits YES, occurs NO, consumes YES. Permits plus consumes without occurs is a
mutation surviving because the corpus cannot reach it, wearing the costume of a finding --
which is the rule I wrote this morning and nearly broke this afternoon on my own bead.

THE FIX STAYS, smaller: an Option that structurally cannot be None is a false declaration
regardless of callers.

AND THE MEASUREMENT FOUND SOMETHING BETTER BY FAILING. The safety is an ACCIDENT OF TWO
IMPLEMENTATIONS, NOT A PROPERTY OF THE INTERFACE. SourceView is a public trait and nothing
in it requires node(ref) to be total over the refs the view exposes, or forbids adjacency
and worldOrder from naming a ref outside the node index. Both implementations happen to
comply. A third that did not would make every consumer of relativePosition silently wrong
and no test would fail. So the right change is a LAW over the trait and its generators, not
new signatures on consumers -- turning an accident into a guarantee at zero downstream cost,
and putting a tripwire at the exact moment someone stops satisfying it.

Two useful things today have now come from measuring a branch I was confident about and
finding it does not fire. Confidence is not the occurs link.
